title: PXDN, TCF4 and TSPAN7 Are Differentially Expressed in B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukaemia: An Integrative Analysis.
authors: Primo, Pasquale; Cecere, Francesco; Cianflone, Alessandra; Mastrodonato, Fiorenza; Maisto, Giovanna; Coppola, Luigi; Giagnuolo, Giovanna; Petruzziello, Fara; Vitagliano, Luigi; Parasole, Rosanna; Menna, Giuseppe; Mirabelli, Peppino
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合转录组分析白血病中差异表达基因，虽涉及TCF4转录因子和AlphaFold蛋白互作预测，但核心是表达谱而非TF-DNA结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Background/Objectives: Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) is a biologically heterogeneous disease in which transcriptional dysregulation contributes to disease onset and progression. Despite survival rates exceeding 90% in high-income countries, relapsed and high-risk cases remain a major clinical challenge, highlighting the need for improved molecular stratification, namely the classification of patients based on genetic and transcriptomic features associated with prognosis, therapeutic response, and disease biology, as well as for the identification of novel therapeutic targets. Methods: We performed an integrative cross-platform analysis to investigate the expression and potential relevance of three candidate genes: PXDN, TCF4, and TSPAN7 in ALL. Gene expression was interrogated across the MILE microarray cohort and the St. Jude Cloud PeCan paediatric RNA-sequencing dataset. Results: Differential expression analyses consistently showed significant upregulation of TCF4 and PXDN in B-cell ALL (B-ALL) across both platforms (adjusted p < 0.001), while TSPAN7 displayed higher expression in T-cell ALL (T-ALL) and variable upregulation in B-ALL. These findings were supported by preliminary validation using quantitative PCR in paediatric B-ALL samples. To explore potential functional associations, we performed gene regulatory network inference using scGraphVerse, identifying differentially expressed genes putatively linked to PXDN, TCF4, and TSPAN7. Structural modelling using AlphaFold suggested candidate protein-protein interaction interfaces for a subset of these genes, although these predictions require experimental validation. Functional enrichment analysis indicated an over-representation of developmental pathways associated with PXDN- and TCF4-related networks, whereas TSPAN7-associated genes were enriched in processes linked to neuronal lineage development. Conclusions: Collectively, our results identify, for the first time, PXDN, TCF4 and TSPAN7 as differentially expressed genes in ALL and highlight the usefulness of integrative transcriptomic analyses across independent datasets. While limited by small-scale experimental validation and reliance on computational predictions, this study provides a framework for prioritising candidate genes and generates testable hypotheses regarding their potential involvement in leukaemia-associated molecular pathways.
abstract_zh: 背景/目标：急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）是一种生物学异质性疾病，其中转录失调 contributes to 疾病发生和进展。尽管高收入国家的生存率超过90%，但复发和高危病例仍是主要临床挑战，凸显了改进分子分层（即基于与预后、治疗反应和疾病生物学相关的遗传和转录组特征对患者进行分类）以及识别新型治疗靶点的必要性。方法：我们进行了整合性跨平台分析，以研究三个候选基因PXDN、TCF4和TSPAN7在ALL中的表达及其潜在相关性。基因表达在MILE微阵列队列和St. Jude Cloud PeCan儿科RNA测序数据集中进行了查询。结果：差异表达分析一致显示，在两个平台中，TCF4和PXDN在B细胞ALL（B-ALL）中显著上调（调整后p < 0.001），而TSPAN7在T细胞ALL（T-ALL）中显示更高表达，并在B-ALL中呈现可变上调。这些发现得到了儿科B-ALL样本中定量PCR初步验证的支持。为探索潜在功能关联，我们使用scGraphVerse进行了基因调控网络推断，识别出与PXDN、TCF4和TSPAN7可能相关的差异表达基因。使用AlphaFold的结构建模提示了其中一部分基因的候选蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用界面，尽管这些预测需要实验验证。功能富集分析表明，与PXDN和TCF4相关网络相关的发育通路过度表达，而TSPAN7相关基因则富集于与神经元谱系发育相关的过程。结论：综合来看，我们的结果首次将PXDN、TCF4和TSPAN7识别为ALL中的差异表达基因，并强调了跨独立数据集整合转录组分析的有用性。尽管受限于小规模实验验证和对计算预测的依赖，本研究为候选基因优先排序提供了框架，并生成了关于它们可能参与白血病相关分子通路的可测试假设。
